subject: maths
question: The price of fuel decreases by 45%, 55% and 50% in three successive months, but increases by 40% in the fourth month. What is the percentage increase/decrease in the price of fuel in the fourth month as compared to its original price? (Round off the answer to two decimal places.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Take initial price = 100

After decreases ⇒ 100 × 0.55 × 0.45 × 0.50 = 12.375

Increase 40% ⇒ 12.375 × 1.40 = 17.325

Net change = 17.325 − 100 = −82.675%

**∴ Answer = 82.68% decrease**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Successive changes: −45%, −55%, −50%, +40%

**Formula used:**

Final value = Initial × (1 ± change)₁ × (1 ± change)₂ ...

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let initial price = 100

⇒ After 1st month = 100 × 0.55 = 55

⇒ After 2nd month = 55 × 0.45 = 24.75

⇒ After 3rd month = 24.75 × 0.50 = 12.375

⇒ After 4th month = 12.375 × 1.40 = 17.325

⇒ Net change = (17.325 − 100) = −82.675

⇒ Percentage change = −82.675%

**∴ The correct answer is 82.68% decrease.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage

Multiply factors: (1 − a)(1 − b)(1 − c)(1 + d).

Shortcut Tip

Always convert percentages into multipliers.

Rounding Rule

Round final answer to required decimal places.
